text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Swan Stakes, where we promised to put
Bamboo Memory's skills to the test,
is finally here!
As for how Bamboo
Memory is feeling...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! I'm ready to go, go, GO!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Honestly, I'm pretty surprised
myself!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My heart's burning up so hot,
I feel like I might
explode! And I can't stop shaking!
But my mind's
so clear!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But more than anything, I can't wait to
get out
there and RUN!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
